name: GitHub MCP
description: Curated GitHub REST API collection with 30 MCP tools (github.com and GitHub Enterprise Server).

variables.name: github_api_url
variables.description: GitHub REST API base URL without a trailing slash: https://api.github.com or https://<host>/api/v3 for GitHub Enterprise Server

variables.name: github_owner
variables.description: Default repository owner (user or organization login)

variables.name: github_token
variables.description: GitHub fine-grained or classic personal access token

requests.name: GitHub Get Authenticated User
requests.mcp_description: Return the GitHub user that owns the configured token.

requests.name: GitHub Get Repository
requests.mcp_description: Get the repository (default branch, visibility, permissions). Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

requests.name: GitHub List Workflows
requests.mcp_description: List GitHub Actions workflows of the repository (paginated); each has a numeric id and a file path. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitHub max 100). Defaults to 30.

requests.name: GitHub List Workflow Runs
requests.mcp_description: List GitHub Actions workflow runs across the whole repository (paginated, filterable). Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

branch.description: Optional branch name filter (raw value, encoded once by the HTTP client).

status.description: Optional status or conclusion filter, e.g. queued, in_progress, completed, success, failure.

event.description: Optional triggering event filter, e.g. push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitHub max 100). Defaults to 30.

requests.name: GitHub List Workflow Runs For Workflow
requests.mcp_description: List runs of one GitHub Actions workflow, identified by numeric ID or file name (paginated, filterable). Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

workflow_id.description: Workflow numeric ID as a decimal string (for example 161335) or the workflow file name (for example ci.yml).

branch.description: Optional branch name filter (raw value, encoded once by the HTTP client).

status.description: Optional status or conclusion filter, e.g. queued, in_progress, completed, success, failure.

event.description: Optional triggering event filter, e.g. push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitHub max 100). Defaults to 30.

requests.name: GitHub Get Workflow Run
requests.mcp_description: Get one GitHub Actions workflow run by numeric run ID. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

run_id.description: Workflow run numeric ID (decimal string or integer).

requests.name: GitHub Rerun Workflow Run
requests.body: {% set ns = namespace(sep="") %}{ {% if mcp is defined and mcp.request is defined and mcp.request.enable_debug_logging is defined and mcp.request.enable_debug_logging is not none %}{{ ns.sep }}"enable_debug_logging": {% if mcp.request.enable_debug_logging %}true{% else %}false{% endif %}{% set ns.sep = ", " %}{% endif %} }
requests.mcp_description: Re-run a whole GitHub Actions workflow run. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

run_id.description: Workflow run numeric ID (decimal string or integer).

enable_debug_logging.description: Optional: true enables debug logging for the re-run.

requests.name: GitHub Cancel Workflow Run
requests.mcp_description: Cancel a queued or in-progress GitHub Actions workflow run. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

run_id.description: Workflow run numeric ID (decimal string or integer).

requests.name: GitHub List Workflow Run Jobs
requests.mcp_description: List jobs of a GitHub Actions workflow run (paginated). Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

run_id.description: Workflow run numeric ID (decimal string or integer).

filter.description: Optional: latest (default) returns jobs of the latest attempt; all returns every attempt.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitHub max 100). Defaults to 30.

requests.name: GitHub Get Workflow Job
requests.mcp_description: Get one GitHub Actions job (steps, status, conclusion) by numeric job ID. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

job_id.description: Workflow job numeric ID (decimal string or integer).

requests.name: GitHub Dispatch Workflow
requests.body: {% set ns = namespace(sep="") %}{ {% if mcp is defined and mcp.request is defined and mcp.request.inputs is defined and mcp.request.inputs is not none %}{{ ns.sep }}"inputs": { {% for k, v in mcp.request.inputs.items() %}{% if not loop.first %}, {% endif %}{{ to_json_string(k) }}: {% if v is sameas true %}"true"{% elif v is sameas false %}"false"{% else %}{{ to_json_string(v) }}{% endif %}{% endfor %} }{% set ns.sep = ", " %}{% endif %}{% if mcp is defined and mcp.request is defined and mcp.request.ref is defined and mcp.request.ref is not none %}{{ ns.sep }}"ref": {{ to_json_string(mcp.request.ref) }}{% set ns.sep = ", " %}{% endif %} }
requests.mcp_description: Trigger a workflow_dispatch event for a GitHub Actions workflow. The workflow must declare an on: workflow_dispatch trigger; ref is a branch or tag. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

workflow_id.description: Workflow numeric ID as a decimal string (for example 161335) or the workflow file name (for example ci.yml).

ref.description: Branch or tag name to run the workflow on.

inputs.description: Optional workflow inputs as a JSON object with scalar values only, at most 25 keys; values are sent as strings (booleans as "true"/"false").

requests.name: GitHub List Pull Requests
requests.mcp_description: List pull requests of the repository (paginated, filterable by state, head and base). Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

state.description: Optional state filter: open (default), closed or all.

head.description: Optional head filter in user:branch or org:branch form.

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitHub max 100). Defaults to 30.

requests.name: GitHub Get Pull Request
requests.mcp_description: Get one pull request by its repository-scoped number. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

pull_number.description: Pull request number shown in the UI: a repository-scoped number, not a global ID (decimal string or integer).

requests.mcp_description: Open a pull request. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

requests.mcp_description: Create a review comment on a diff line or file of a pull request. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

pull_number.description: Pull request number shown in the UI: a repository-scoped number, not a global ID (decimal string or integer).

commit_id.description: SHA of the commit to comment on (usually the pull request head SHA).

path.description: Relative path of the file to comment on.

line.description: Optional diff line number (decimal string or integer).

side.description: Optional diff side: LEFT or RIGHT.

start_line.description: Optional first line of a multi-line comment (decimal string or integer).

start_side.description: Optional side of start_line: LEFT or RIGHT.

comment_id.description: Review comment numeric ID (decimal string or integer).

requests.mcp_description: Create and submit a pull request review. event is required and must be one of APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, COMMENT (other values are rejected by GitHub with 422); REQUEST_CHANGES and COMMENT also need body. The review is submitted immediately: pending (draft) reviews are not supported. Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

pull_number.description: Pull request number shown in the UI: a repository-scoped number, not a global ID (decimal string or integer).

event.description: Required review action: one of APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, COMMENT (other values are rejected by GitHub with 422).

body.description: Review text (Markdown); required by GitHub for REQUEST_CHANGES and COMMENT.

commit_id.description: Optional commit SHA the review applies to (defaults to the latest commit).

requests.name: GitHub List Issues
requests.mcp_description: List issues of the repository (paginated). GitHub also returns pull requests here (they carry a pull_request key). Uses the endpoint's github_owner/github_repo; pass github_owner and/or github_repo to target another repository; if no default is configured you must pass them.

state.description: Optional state filter: open (default), closed or all.

labels.description: Optional comma-separated label names (a string here, unlike the labels array of create/update).

page.description: Page number (decimal string or integer, 1-based). Defaults to 1.

per_page.description: Items per page (decimal string or integer, GitHub max 100). Defaults to 30.
